title: Catchplate native ingress session evidence v1
description: Original session quotation only. The wire object is compact JSON plus one LF, at most 98304 bytes. Schema shape does not verify TLS exporter provenance, a Nitro signature, certificate or peer identity, freshness, enrollment, authorization, current witness state or readiness. The verifier must compare the echoed challenge/exporter with independently retained actual client-session values, never adopt these echoes as expectations.

clientChallengeBase64url.description: Echo of the caller's raw nonzero 32-byte challenge, not proof of its freshness or one-use reservation.

tlsExporterBase64url.description: Echo of the actual 32-byte exporter for fixed label EXPORTER-Catchplate-Native-Ingress-v1 and raw caller challenge context. A consumer must use its independently observed actual TLS exporter, not trust this echo.

publicIdentityBase64url.description: Canonical unpadded URL-safe base64 of the exact nativeIngressPublicEvidence/v1 original line, including its final LF, at most 65536 decoded bytes. Runtime verification requires nested scope unverified-session-public-material and the same retained ingress key with nonce SHA256(fixed NUL-terminated session domain || challenge32 || exporter32). JSON Schema does not decode or verify that nested evidence.
